folder.description: The parent folder for the IAM policy binding. Must be a valid numeric GCP folder ID.
folder.rationale: Ensures IAM policy is applied only at a valid folder scope.

location.description: The location of the policy binding. Must always be global for folder IAM bindings.
location.rationale: IAM folder bindings are global to ensure consistent access control.

policy_binding_id.description: Unique identifier for the policy binding.
policy_binding_id.rationale: Ensures each binding is uniquely identifiable.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable name for the policy binding (max 63 characters).
display_name.non-compliant: This name is way too long and not valid for IAM folder binding display name usage

annotations.description: Optional metadata used for tagging and classification.
annotations.rationale: Does not affect IAM security enforcement.

non-compliant.notes: this is an invalid overly long annotation example used for testing purposes and should not be used in production environments because it violates expected size constraints

policy_kind.description: Type of IAM policy being applied (e.g., ACCESS or PRINCIPAL_ACCESS_BOUNDARY).
policy_kind.rationale: Defines how IAM policy is enforced.

target.description: Full resource name of the target folder where the policy is applied.
target.rationale: Defines the exact scope of IAM enforcement.

principal_set.description: Principal set used for access boundary enforcement within the folder.
principal_set.rationale: Restricts access to approved identities within folder boundary.

condition.description: Optional CEL condition for conditional IAM access control.

compliant.title: Folder access rule
compliant.description: Allows access only to folder resources

expression.description: CEL expression defining IAM condition logic.
